## About
Apex Auto & Transmission Repair is a local shop on University Ave NW in Coon Rapids. We work on cars and transmissions, and we're open Monday through Friday.
Our customers have given us a 4.6 rating from 113 Google reviews. One longtime customer mentioned Sang and his team by name and said they actually care about the people they help.

## Services
- Transmission repair: Transmission work is right there in our name.
- Clutch work: One reviewer said we did a great job on a clutch that went out.
- General auto repair: Repair and maintenance for the car you drive every day.

## FAQ
